$schema_note: Machine-readable Google Sheets contract for Marketing Scout. Single source of truth for tab names, scope columns, retention class and protections. tools/validate_sheet_contracts.js asserts every workflow Sheets node targets a declared tab; n8n/lib/sheet_audit.js validates row content at runtime; n8n/lib/retention_policy.js enforces retention + protections. Offline, no secrets.

retention_classes.operational: request work product; eligible after retention_days unless its request is active or its report is retained
retention_classes.report: user-facing reports + report data; recent reports protected
retention_classes.outbox: delivery queue; unsent entries are protected

$bootstrap_note: sheet_order + headers + identity_columns below are the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Stage 3 staging bootstrap (tools/gen_sheets_bootstrap_workflow.js, n8n/lib/sheets_contract_resolver.js). Header order is canonical and sourced from the repository schema docs / library row shapes (provenance in config/sheets_ui_contracts.json `_provenance`). headers[tab] is always a superset of tabs[tab].required_columns. Tabs written by more than one workflow generation carry the UNION of every writer's columns (n8n Google Sheets append maps by header NAME, so a tab missing a writer's column silently drops that field). Add a new tab by appending its name to sheet_order and an ordered list to headers; no engine change is required.

execution_plans.purpose: durable execution plan store; a plan is persisted before approval and bound to it by plan_hash (WF19-PLAN-001 / WF18-APPROVAL-002)

weekly_digests.purpose: emitted weekly digests (one per owner per ISO week)

vk_posts.purpose: collected VK public wall posts (canonical records)

candidate_sources.purpose: DISCOVERY-003: discovered competitor/source CANDIDATES (not monitored until approved/added)

llm_analysis_results.purpose: Stage F: persisted evidence-bound Claude analysis results (typed structured_result_json). Reusable by evidence_package_hash.

llm_analysis_telemetry.purpose: Stage F: per-call Claude telemetry (tokens, cost, latency, schema_mode, repair/fallback, error_category). No secrets, no chain-of-thought.

technical_errors.purpose: WF04/WF03/WF02 route: a record whose scrape/parse ended in a technical error (needs_manual_review=true). Same 54-column record family as the queues. Diagnostic only — never a user-facing source. Carries parse_error + a truncated raw_response_preview for triage; NEVER an auth header, credential or full provider payload.

skipped_log.purpose: WF04 route: a record skipped BEFORE any paid Firecrawl/Claude call (duplicate source_url already in url_registry). Same 54-column record family. Proves a dedup skip cost nothing.

results.purpose: WF02/WF03/WF04/WF08 route: an accepted record that needs no queue triage (e.g. a lead_signal). Same 54-column record family as the other route tabs. Completes the route contract — every value Normalize+Route can emit now maps to a declared tab (WF04-ROUTE-001).
